rca_of_issue: Recurring user complaint: mark price on position cards blinked ~2 times then went static. Two compounding root causes, both verified fixed: (1) useBinanceMultiTicker's data watchdog previously only guarded the FIRST message — a socket that stalled after a few ticks (common with fstream.binance.com in restricted networks: handshake succeeds, then silence) was never detected, so no fallback ever triggered mid-session. Fix: rolling watchdog re-arms a 30s inactivity timer on EVERY message; silence -> ws.close() -> reconnect rotation to next host (fstream -> data-stream.binance.vision -> stream.binance.com:9443). Verified live this run: fstream silent-dead -> closed at ~10.7s -> vision host drove 693 frames/85s, 16 distinct marks, longest static run 2 samples. (2) The 300ms backend prices poll had no in-flight guard — slow 2-5s responses on mobile stacked overlapping requests and froze updates. Fix: tick skipped while previous request in flight. PnL is recomputed from live mark each tick ((live-entry)*qty) — verified correlated to the cent on 6/6 precise samples.
